  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref

Implemented **LAST LIGHT**, an original 3D island-survival shooter for desktop and mobile.

It includes a low-poly island, rival operators, shooting and reloading, pickups, a shrinking safe zone, match outcomes, and restart and pause flows. Controls support keyboard and mouse as well as mobile touch controls.

**Assumptions:** This is a single-player arena with AI opponents—not PUBG, and not a networked battle royale. The game uses procedural scenery and original assets.

Validation included a JavaScript syntax check and browser checks for starting, pausing, mobile layout, and firing. The changes are uncommitted.
